scenes.say: Night four. It's freezing. The old man brings out a gas camping heater and wants to use it inside.

scenes.say: Keep it off. Gas heaters and grills made for outdoors can fill a closed room with carbon monoxide. You can't see it or smell it, and it can kill you in your sleep.
